verdict.rationale: Ollama documents itself as a backend for coding agents. It offers Anthropic Messages API compatibility so Claude Code runs on open models, an OpenAI-compatible API subset, and an `ollama launch` command that sets up Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex against local or cloud models with no config files. The GitHub README corroborates connections to Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and OpenCode. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that coding agents work reliably against it, and the OpenAI compatibility covers only a subset of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend

citations.quote: Ollama is now compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, making it possible to use tools like Claude Code with open models.
ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models. No environment variables or config files needed.
connect Ollama to your existing agents or applications such as `Claude Code`, `OpenClaw`, `OpenCode` , `Codex`, `Copilot`,  and more.
Ollama lets you use open models with your coding agents so you can spend less while keeping your data private.
